items.title: Election year "poop water" claims lead wealthy suburb to drop recycling plan
items.dek: Scottsdale, Ariz. — A Phoenix suburb ditched a plan to send recycled water from toilets and other sources directly to residents' taps after political candidates
items.body: Scottsdale, Ariz. — A Phoenix suburb ditched a plan to send recycled water from toilets and other sources directly to residents' taps after political candidates made unproven claims that the water is contaminated "poop water." submitted by /u/Collie_Opterous [link] [comments]
